root.label: Benny Caldera arrested over alleged Texas Capitol attack plan

events.label: Benny Caldera arrested over alleged Texas Capitol attack plan

slots.name: custody status
slots.sentence: Caldera was released from the Bexar County Jail into federal custody on Wednesday, where he will remain, according to Texas DPS.

slots.name: Capitol operating status
slots.sentence: Texas DPS said its leadership team notified state lawmakers about the threat and arrest earlier in the day on Wednesday, and that the Capitol building remained open for regular operating hours.

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: The agency said it received credible information on Tuesday that 40-year-old Benny Caldera Jr. was planning the attack for Thursday, Oct. 1.

slots.name: ammunition count
slots.sentence: During the search of his home, Texas DPS Criminal Investigation Division agents allegedly found a .357 revolver loaded with six rounds and a 12-gauge shotgun in his master bedroom closet, along with six 9mm rounds.

slots.name: arrest time
slots.sentence: The arrest happened at 3 a.m. Wednesday, the agency said.
